title: Export Microsoft 365 Copilot user activity (CSV) from Microsoft Graph v1.0
summary: Download the 28-day Microsoft 365 Copilot usage user-detail report from the v1.0 copilot/reports endpoint as CSV with Microsoft Graph PowerShell and list licensed users with no recent activity.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'Reports.Read.All'

# v1.0 returns a CSV stream; default report version is v2 (periods D7, D28, D90, D180, ALL)
$uri = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/copilot/reports/getMicrosoft365CopilotUsageUserDetail(period='D28')"
Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method GET -Uri $uri -OutputFilePath .\copilot-usage-D28.csv

$rows = Import-Csv .\copilot-usage-D28.csv
$rows | Where-Object { -not $_.'Last Activity Date' } |
  Select-Object 'User Principal Name', 'Display Name' |
  Export-Csv .\copilot-no-activity-D28.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
notes: Delegated use needs Reports.Read.All plus a report-reading role (for example Reports Reader or AI Administrator); application permission Reports.Read.All works for automation.
Only users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence appear; unlicensed Copilot Chat usage is in the admin center Copilot Chat report or the audit log.
If the reports privacy setting conceals user details, names and UPNs come back as hashes.
D30 is only valid with version='v1'; the default v2 report uses D28.

source.label: Pull Copilot usage via Microsoft Graph reports API
